
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)


reef_data <- read_csv("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Coral_cover_lit_review/coral_reef_timeseries_avg.csv")

reef_region4 <- reef_data %>% 
  filter(rgn_id == "Region_4")

reef_region9 <- reef_data %>% 
  filter(rgn_id == "Region_9")

```

## Region 4
```{r}
ggplot(reef_region4, aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = reef_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Coral Cover",
    color = "Reef",
    title = "Time series of coral cover at common sites (Region 4)"
  )

```

```{r}
# make sure year is numeric and factors are set
reef_region4 <- reef_region4 %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    reef_name = factor(reef_name),
    rgn_id = factor(rgn_id)
  )
```

```{r}
# Filter Region 4 for Cabo Pulmo
cabo <- reef_region4 %>% 
  filter(reef_name == "Cabo Pulmo")

# Split into two time periods
cabo_1991_2012 <- cabo %>% filter(year >= 1991, year <= 2012)
cabo_2013_2023 <- cabo %>% filter(year >= 2013, year <= 2023)

# Calculate averages for each period
avg_1991_2012 <- mean(cabo_1991_2012$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_2013_2023 <- mean(cabo_2013_2023$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# Create a data frame for mean lines so they appear in the legend
mean_df <- data.frame(
  period = c("Mean 1991–2012", "Mean 2013–2023"),
  mean_value = c(avg_1991_2012, avg_2013_2023)
)

my_colors <- c(
  "1991–2012" = "blue",
  "2013–2023" = "orange",
  "Mean 1991–2012" = "blue",
  "Mean 2013–2023" = "orange"
)


ggplot() +
  # Time series 1991–2012
  geom_line(data = cabo_1991_2012,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = cabo_1991_2012,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
             size = 2) +
  
  # Time series 2013–2023
  geom_line(data = cabo_2013_2023,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = cabo_2013_2023,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
             size = 2) +

  
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Coral Cover",
    color = "Time Period",
    title = "Cabo Pulmo Coral Cover Trends: 1991–2012 vs. 2013–2023",
    caption = "Figure 1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 40)
  )
```

```{r}
# Create a data frame for mean lines so they appear in the legend
mean_df <- data.frame(
  period = c("Mean 1991–2012", "Mean 2013–2023"),
  mean_value = c(avg_1991_2012, avg_2013_2023)
)

my_colors <- c(
  "1991–2012" = "blue",
  "2013–2023" = "orange",
  "Mean 1991–2012" = "blue",
  "Mean 2013–2023" = "orange"
)


ggplot() +
  # Time series 1991–2012
  geom_line(data = cabo_1991_2012,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = cabo_1991_2012,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
             size = 2) +
  
  # Time series 2013–2023
  geom_line(data = cabo_2013_2023,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = cabo_2013_2023,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
             size = 2) +
  
  # Mean lines
  geom_hline(data = mean_df,
             aes(yintercept = mean_value, color = period),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.55) +
  
  # Mean value labels (left side)
  geom_text(data = mean_df,
            aes(x = min(cabo_1991_2012$year), y = mean_value,
                label = paste0(round(mean_value, 1), "%"), color = period),
            hjust = 1.8, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Coral Cover",
    color = "Time Period",
    title = "Cabo Pulmo Coral Cover Trends: 1991–2012 vs. 2013–2023",
    caption = "Figure 1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 40)
  )
```

```{r}
  data = reef_region4
)

summary(fe_model)
```


## Condition
```{r}
corals_extent <- read_csv(here::here("BD", "HAB", "hab_corals", "habitat_services_output_pushed", "corals_extent.csv"))

# Filter coral extent df for Region 4 and Region 9
coral_area_df <- corals_extent |>
  filter(rgn_id %in% c("Region_4", "Region_9")) |>
  select(rgn_id, area_km2)

# Coral cover averages for Region 4 and Region 9
# Build dataframe
coral_status_df <- tibble(
  rgn_id        = c("Region 4", "Region 9"),
  area_km2      = c(6.0269192, 0.5430808),
  year          = 2025,
  avg_1991_2012 = avg_1991_2012,
  avg_2013_2023 = avg_2013_2023,
  current_status = (avg_2013_2023 / avg_1991_2012) * 100
)

coral_status_df

```
```{r}
coral_status_df |>
  kable(
    digits = 3,
    col.names = c(
      "Region ID",
      "Area (km²)",
      "Year",
      "Avg Coral Cover 1991–2012",
      "Avg Coral Cover 2013–2023",
      "Current Status (%)"
    ),
    align = c("c", "r", "c", "r", "r", "r")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(
    c(" " = 1, "Coral Condition Status (2025)" = 5)
  )

```

```{r}
reef_region9_two <- reef_region9_clean %>%
  filter(reef_name %in% c(
    "Punta Mita (Bahía Banderas)",
    "Isla María Cleofas (Nayarit offshore)"
  ))

reef_pre2013 <- reef_region9_two %>% filter(year < 2013)
reef_post2013 <- reef_region9_two %>% filter(year >= 2013)

mean_pre <- mean(reef_pre2013$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_post <- mean(reef_post2013$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)

condition_score <- (mean_post / mean_pre) * 100

region9_condition <- tibble(
  rgn_id = "Region 9",
  area_km2 = 0.5430808,
  avg_1991_2012 = mean_pre,
  avg_2013_2023 = mean_post,
  year = 2025,
  current_status = condition_score
)

region9_condition

```
```{r}
coral_condition_combined <- bind_rows(
  coral_status_df,
  region9_condition
)
coral_condition_combined <- coral_condition_combined[-2, ]
coral_condition_combined
```

```{r}
coral_condition_combined_ecorgn <- coral_condition_combined %>%
  mutate(
    region_name = case_when(

    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"),

    c("Coral Current Status (2025)" = 3)
  )
```

```{r}
reef_post2013 <- reef_region9_two %>% filter(year >= 2013)

# Calculate averages
mean_pre <- mean(reef_pre2013$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_post <- mean(reef_post2013$percent_coral_cover, na.rm = TRUE)

# Data frame for mean lines
mean_df_9 <- data.frame(
  period = c("Mean 1991–2012", "Mean 2013–2023"),
  mean_value = c(mean_pre, mean_post)
)

# Colors
my_colors_9 <- c(
  "1991–2012" = "blue",
  "2013–2023" = "orange",
  "Mean 1991–2012" = "blue",
  "Mean 2013–2023" = "orange"
)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  # Time series 1991–2012
  geom_line(data = reef_pre2013,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = reef_pre2013,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "1991–2012"),
             size = 2) +
  
  # Time series 2013–2023
  geom_line(data = reef_post2013,
            aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
            size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = reef_post2013,
             aes(x = year, y = percent_coral_cover, color = "2013–2023"),
             size = 2) +
  
  # Mean lines
  geom_hline(data = mean_df_9,
             aes(yintercept = mean_value, color = period),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.55) +
  
  # Mean value labels
  geom_text(data = mean_df_9,
            aes(x = min(reef_pre2013$year), y = mean_value,
                label = paste0(round(mean_value, 1), "%"), color = period),
            hjust = 2.3, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors_9) +
  
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Coral Cover",
    color = "Time Period",
    title = "Region 9 Coral Cover Trends: 1991–2012 vs. 2013–2023",
    caption = "Figure 2"

  theme_minimal() +

    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),

    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 40)
  )
```

```{r}
# Prepare coral condition data for join
coral_condition_map <- coral_condition_combined %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub(" ", "_", rgn_id),
    current_status_int = round(current_status, 0),

    # Categorize into meaningful bins
    status_cat = case_when(
      current_status_int >= 80 ~ "Good (80–100)",
      current_status_int >= 60 ~ "Moderate (60–79)",
      current_status_int >= 40 ~ "Fair (40–59)",
      TRUE ~ "Poor (0–39)"
    )
  )

# Join onto OHI polygons
ohi_coral_condition <- ohi_regions %>%
  left_join(coral_condition_map, by = "rgn_id")

# Split marine vs land
ohi_marine <- ohi_coral_condition %>% filter(location == "marine")
ohi_land   <- ohi_coral_condition %>% filter(location == "land")

# Custom colors
status_colors <- c(
  "Good (80–100)" = "#1a9850",      # green
  "Moderate (60–79)" = "#fee08b",  # yellow
  "Fair (40–59)" = "#fdae61",      # orange
  "Poor (0–39)" = "#d73027"        # red
)

# Plot
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(ohi_land) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "#f5e6c8",
    border.col = "gray40",
    lwd = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

tm_shape(ohi_marine) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "status_cat",
    palette = status_colors,
    alpha = 0.85,
    title = "Coral Current Status (2025)",
    border.col = "black",
    lwd = 1.2
  ) +

tm_layout(
  title = "Coral Current Status (2025)",
  frame = FALSE,
  legend.outside = TRUE
)


```
